# Yahoo Finance

> Yahoo Finance is a comprehensive financial platform providing real-time stock quotes, market data, portfolio management tools, and breaking financial news covering stocks, cryptocurrencies, economic policy, and global markets.

Yahoo Finance serves as a central hub for individual investors and financial professionals seeking live market information, earnings reports, and analysis across US and global markets. The platform integrates real-time data from major exchanges (NYSE, NASDAQ) with curated financial news and specialized coverage of sectors including technology, real estate, and cryptocurrency.

## Key Topics

- Real-time stock quotes
- Market indices (S&P 500, Nasdaq, Dow 30)
- Portfolio tracking and management
- Earnings reports and company financials
- Federal Reserve and monetary policy
- Cryptocurrency and Bitcoin
- Stock market screeners
- Financial news and analysis
- US and global markets
- Interest rates and mortgage rates
- Technology sector coverage
- Investment analysis
- Market data and trading volume
- Economic news
- Commodities and oil prices

## Core Market Data & Tools

- [Yahoo Finance Home](https://finance.yahoo.com): Yahoo Finance homepage with live stock quotes, market indices, and financial news
- [Markets Overview](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets): Global markets overview with indices, futures, bonds, currencies, and ETFs
- [Portfolio Management & Tracker](https://finance.yahoo.com/portfolios): Portfolio management and tracking tool with real-time updates and performance metrics
- [Most Active Stocks](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/most-active): Most active stocks list with trading volume and market data
- [Top Gaining Stocks](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/gainers): Top gaining stocks screener with daily performance and price changes
- [US Stocks Screener](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks): Most active US stocks screener with trading volume and real-time quotes

## Financial News & Analysis

- [Finance News Hub](https://finance.yahoo.com/news): Financial news hub covering Wall Street, markets, stocks, and securities
- [Latest News](https://finance.yahoo.com/topic/latest-news): Latest financial news aggregation with earnings reports and market updates
- [Yahoo Finance Originals](https://finance.yahoo.com/topic/yahoo-finance-originals): Original Yahoo Finance content on markets, economics, and Federal Reserve
- [Premium News](https://finance.yahoo.com/topic/premium-news): Premium subscriber content from Financial Times and MT Newswires
- [Stock Market News](https://finance.yahoo.com/topic/stock-market-news): Stock market news with earnings analysis and investment insights

## Earnings & Company Coverage

- [Earnings Reports](https://finance.yahoo.com/topic/earnings): Earnings reports, transcripts, and company financial results analysis
- [Federal Reserve Live Updates](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/live/fed-meeting-live-updates-federal-reserve-holds-rates-steady-forecasts-1-rate-cut-in-2026-180216872.html): Live Federal Reserve meeting updates on interest rates and monetary policy
- [Economic News](https://finance.yahoo.com/topic/economic-news): Economic news on Federal Reserve policy, inflation, and interest rates

## Sector & Asset Coverage

- [Cryptocurrency & Bitcoin News](https://finance.yahoo.com/topic/crypto): Cryptocurrency news covering Bitcoin, Ethereum, and digital assets
- [Technology News](https://finance.yahoo.com/topic/tech): Technology sector news covering AI investments and company announcements
- [Housing Market News](https://finance.yahoo.com/topic/housing-market): Housing market news with mortgage rates and real estate investment guides
- [Tariffs & Trade Policy](https://finance.yahoo.com/topic/tariffs): Trade policy and tariff news impacting markets and retail sectors
- [Tax News](https://finance.yahoo.com/topic/hrb-2026): Tax news, deductions, and filing guidance for 2025 tax season

## Subscriptions & Newsletters

- [Newsletter Signup](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/sign-up-for-yahoo-finances-morning-brief-174158888.html): Newsletter signup for Morning Brief and financial news subscriptions
